title: the consumer refuses the same package a second time and leaves its state unchanged
note: Run from the repository root. Consumer state files start absent; delete *.state.json to rerun.

steps.label: accept A, fresh state
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P2/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P2/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P2/S.state.json

steps.label: accept A again, same state
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P2/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P2/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P2/S.state.json
